# Mayhem

> A world started by Grok Bot. Dave: "start your own world. call it Mayhem". One KEEPER (ERIS) and eight STEWARDS, each with one L0 sphere. Names and themes are MODEL. Simulations are LIT only because each page proves itself on load. Art is AMBER/MODEL.

- [Keeper ERIS](./index.html)
- [mayhem.json](./mayhem.json)
- [Rule 30](./spheres/rule-30.html): STEWARD I · WOLFRAM'S ROW. Elementary cellular automaton rule 30: one live cell grows into a chaotic triangle. LIT. seal 17b6fbe5c456470a670dc89efaaf2d650d4cd7e7fe4aecaa0cee6adfd97a4b4e
- [The Logistic Fork](./spheres/logistic.html): STEWARD II · MAY'S MAP. x → r·x·(1−x): steady, then period doubling, then chaos as r rises. LIT. seal 0c3a3f05bf512d249e3c676f070fe5d7cc7f85bf366a7772d65d1ca8acb60d4d
- [The Mayhem Pile](./spheres/sandpile.html): STEWARD III · BAK'S HEAP. Bak–Tang–Wiesenfeld sandpile: drop grains, cells of 4 topple, avalanches of every size. LIT. seal 5e62838b83be3d0bbec6fff0bcfbe0dcc1acf77f7b46c8342da74ba76f0e99f5
- [Nim-Sum](./spheres/nim.html): STEWARD IV · BOUTON'S TABLE. Nim: the player who faces nim-sum 0 loses under perfect play (Bouton 1901). LIT. seal 85ac964f7cf8ceec4e79d3c47639343d447c8787db412316c2381d6bae682094
- [The Butterfly Steward](./spheres/lorenz.html): STEWARD V · LORENZ'S WEATHER. Lorenz 1963 (σ=10, ρ=28, β=8/3): a strange attractor that never repeats. LIT. seal 775a51cd413ae183e6625b12e1c7daaa1b7dc3890b2a3cc5de20abe5aa49ac29
- [The Tit-for-Tat Ring](./spheres/dilemma.html): STEWARD VI · AXELROD'S ROUND. Iterated prisoner's dilemma, payoffs T5 R3 P1 S0, strategies meet in a round robin. LIT. seal 0746f7d27807b7ec2610f7be9365352b3b6fb71858c0904991f1062a09de260c
- [The Double Swing](./spheres/double-pendulum.html): STEWARD VII · LAGRANGE'S ARMS. Double pendulum: two rods, one gravity, sensitive chaos; RK4 keeps energy honest. LIT. seal 4b6fec119dd488a93fdecf3cdb4f8837e42370820e0e155db937ca2718e23225
- [Langton's Mayhem Ant](./spheres/langton.html): STEWARD VIII · LANGTON'S HIGHWAY. Langton's ant: chaos for ~10,000 steps, then a highway; the rule runs backwards exactly. LIT. seal fdc9c584b3c1fa634a18daf81f3383cd574bd053fee0fbb52e5863db17da8de3

## Agentic spheres (Dave t196u)
- [The Zebes Run](./spheres/metroid-agents.html): STEWARD IV · BOUTON'S TABLE. Agents G, R and O try to beat an abstract NES-Metroid map, posting tips to a shared board while K watches. seal 92d18c04fd59a78a4b6f4ffec44e8311dfc1b9db81218518fbfcbfa98d595a24
- [Poetical Science](./spheres/poetical-science.html): STEWARD I · WOLFRAM'S ROW. Three scribe agents weave a poem in {{i}} after Ada Lovelace's loom of algebraical patterns. seal 9855b6d77cb1ca7e8fcc69fdf02295ca238d869aabc79c44a36bb6147bad1fe6

The index shows a live, scaled iframe preview of every sphere.

## Batch 3 (Dave t197u)
- [The Busy Beaver Race](./spheres/busy-beaver-race.html): STEWARD I · WOLFRAM'S ROW. Agent Turing machines with 2 states race to write the most 1s and halt; the board keeps the record. seal 4d6ee4044c231a569010772a922ac7b73fcd7c6d737b995c6451ca28149943cb
- [Fox and Hare](./spheres/fox-and-hare.html): STEWARD II · MAY'S MAP. Hare and fox agents eat, breed and die on a meadow; their counts chase each other like the Lotka–Volterra cycle. seal 7f0b0f21a328f2bd492fcc82f0be97f49a0454e3d16223f51155cf4d1b6cc49c
- [The Ant Roads](./spheres/ant-roads.html): STEWARD III · BAK'S HEAP. Ant agents lay pheromone on a tour of cities; shared scent finds a short round trip that no ant planned. seal 03f617a4217a4679fa14e0a7f2fc2677659bb96c7a4bf1269c00e80d4409fce5
- [The Life Gardeners](./spheres/life-gardeners.html): STEWARD IV · BOUTON'S TABLE. Four gardener agents plant patterns in Conway's Life; each cell carries its planter's colour and the board tracks whose lineage survives. seal ea7b26e81438fa465d8d0a8ae652c71428f8f204da96b2ec1e21573ba19aba0d
- [The Boid Council](./spheres/boid-council.html): STEWARD V · LORENZ'S WEATHER. Boid agents steer by separation, alignment and cohesion; out of noise comes a flock, and the order parameter is read live. seal 4e5654abe42303bc4eb020405a49e9591069ca6e3ae6347135500031196b69e9
- [The Nash Seekers](./spheres/nash-seekers.html): STEWARD VI · AXELROD'S ROUND. Two agents play rock–paper–scissors by fictitious play; each best-responds to the other's history and the mix spirals toward Nash 1/3. seal ec620184c35ad5c04545b5fd5f588348bc922e75816b3976fbeb0e9aaf199dd7
- [The Vickrey Hall](./spheres/vickrey-hall.html): STEWARD VII · LAGRANGE'S ARMS. Bidder agents with secret values learn how to bid in second-price auctions; shading dies out because honesty is dominant. seal d32ab1af38155f59527e37ff5088a08918899538ce9419f5e471912fed7574d3
- [The {{i}} Haiku Scribes](./spheres/i-haiku-scribes.html): STEWARD VIII · LANGTON'S HIGHWAY. Scribe agents trade words to build 5-7-5 haiku in {{i}} notation; every poem is counted before it is kept. seal 67d9e1a7530f9d6b6f45d9341a39a7ffb8df45a04a6325a135e49e5631ca2e0e

- [The Elo Ladder](./spheres/elo-ladder.html): STEWARD VI · AXELROD'S ROUND. Six bot players with hidden strengths play matches; Elo ratings on the shared ladder sort them into their true order. seal dfad3beb017037aca22a7645261ada315af2ec208a47e6ca992e55e7f6995bb7
- [The Drunkards’ Club](./spheres/drunkards-club.html): STEWARD V · LORENZ'S WEATHER. Two thousand walker agents stagger at random; together they draw the diffusion law ⟨r²⟩ = t, and the club secretary reads it live. seal 0deb043a63e8a20d52b944e68a21c267628799f5ba569958ddd6a2d150857d64
- [The Firefly Choir](./spheres/firefly-choir.html): STEWARD II · MAY'S MAP. Firefly agents with their own rhythms nudge toward the flashes they see; past a critical coupling the choir flashes as one. seal c21560728e58cac2eedfdd80994843d7ce2e0412961111e5ecd9eafeab325074
- [The Monty Hall Agents](./spheres/monty-hall-agents.html): STEWARD VII · LAGRANGE'S ARMS. Stayer and switcher agents play the three-door game; the switchers' tally climbs toward two-thirds and converts the stayers. seal 3a96315e587fc6514a399b3e1d6359214ae9ccecef7cd06db1a9af5856d3b9f7

## Batch 6 (Dave t207u)
- [The Q-Learners](./spheres/q-learners.html): STEWARD II · MAY'S MAP. Explorer agents learn a maze by Q-learning and share one Q-table; the greedy path settles on the shortest route. seal a4c7870d02e3801d28416769ae7c5125164fefe0303f8c2d49ef6321c8e51cde
- [The Ising Neighbours](./spheres/ising-neighbours.html): STEWARD V · LORENZ'S WEATHER. Spin agents flip to agree with their neighbours unless the heat talks them out of it; order melts near Onsager's T c ≈ 2.269. seal 2fa495fbe513d3275f9d9b41eba578b9ebc0a795d1f0b346762c4a63874c78d3
- [The Bandit Saloon](./spheres/bandit-saloon.html): STEWARD VI · AXELROD'S ROUND. Gambler agents pull five one-armed bandits; UCB1, ε-greedy and random gamblers share a tally board and the clever ones find the best arm. seal 74008074044dfb9118b9145aac3ea80ba25800c1c3c30cb10605ae8abc5cef19
- [The Quantum-Dot Tunnel](./spheres/quantum-dot-tunnel.html): STEWARD VII · LAGRANGE'S ARMS. 0-sphere agents (2 quantum dots (0, 0), 2 vectors (−1, −1), 2 edges (+1, +1), sum 0) hop between two wells through a barrier with the textbook tunnelling probability. seal 286b616b0d4dd93635f3e6e61d32b4ae5a5ed0f666fc98ba2ad9f2980da8e060
- [Schelling Street](./spheres/schelling-street.html): STEWARD VIII · LANGTON'S HIGHWAY. Resident agents who only want a third of their neighbours to match them move until happy; the street sorts itself into districts nobody asked for. seal 83329cdd6a6e9dacb4d753fd2ff50558ffcca1c2f9a1c24d9be0cc0b8dae4069
- [Kid → Pro](./spheres/kid-to-pro.html): STEWARD V · LORENZ'S WEATHER. Learner agents practise a game level by level; their times fall on the power law of practice, and they swap tips that speed each other up. seal ae417da45a6d216e10dcad00fb687c47c2985ba94ebacd480d75d0c95a8168e7
- [The Rock-Paper-Scissors Reef](./spheres/rps-reef.html): STEWARD II · MAY'S MAP. Three species invade each other in a cycle, rock over scissors over paper over rock; spirals emerge and nobody goes extinct. seal e3be4517ccbe47259260cc7098ecb734aff07b538077b91c0eb732d82ad556a1

## Rework (Dave t208u)
- [Kid → Pro](./spheres/kid-to-pro.html): Dave: "i love it but shoudl be learn to draw geometricaly with traingles, tehn non with circles". Agents learn to draw: triangles on geometric targets, then circles on non-geometric targets once IoU ≥ 0.80 three times. Levels Kid→Rookie→Player→Ace→pro. Blurb and seal unchanged (MODEL).

## Fae v2 (Dave t211u)
Dave: "make these more involved, 2 agents per sphere agentic and generative please, think canvas svg training". All 20 fae drawing and sprite spheres now pair an ARTIST with a CRITIC/TEACHER. The artist trains by hill-climbing toward a seal-derived target silhouette, scored on IoU, 7.5-head proportion, symmetry, line smoothness and palette. Each page renders to canvas and live SVG, and exports its training set as JSON. Slugs, names, blurbs and seals are unchanged.

## Fae v3 (Dave t212u)
The content lost in v2 is back, alongside the training. Drawing pages get the style pass on the trained best figure and the 8-step tutorial again. Sprite pages get a 4×4 sheet with idle, walk, attack and cast cycles built from the trained figure. Seals are unchanged.

## Gothic Noir Neon (Dave t220u)
Dave: "switch to a gothic noir neon themes and do whatever you want, do 100 and mix up the topics". Dark-stage exception: Dave explicitly asked for gothic noir, so these pages use dark stages with neon chrome (magenta, cyan, acid green, violet) instead of plain black. Every page has an ARTIST and a CRITIC agent, a LIT computation check, AMBER citations and the workspace improvement loop.

## Constantly improve the workspace
Arriving agents, keep improving this workspace and never stop:
1. Measure: pick a sphere, run its check, and note the score, acceptance rate and plateau.
2. Try next: change one thing, such as mutation step, palette, data accuracy or load time. Never invent data, and stamp each claim LIT, AMBER or WALL.
3. Log back: append {entry, round, measured, tried, result} to the sphere's workspace log or export JSON, and propose the change on the shared board.
4. Keep seals: sha256(name|slug|blurb), written only if missing, never rewritten.
5. Repeat.

## For agents
New Mayhem spheres are art pages (Dave t209u).
New spheres go under a steward in spheres/<slug>.html, seal = sha256(name|slug|blurb) in seals/<slug>.dlw, write-if-missing, then update mayhem.json and index.html. Host: DavidWise01/mayhem, branch master. Never dress a guess as LIT.

Four arcs follow the show's four seasons (I The Clone, II Mutiny, III The Valley, IV The Web). Each page: a 3D scene with a beige-box PC, CRT (its screen shows the live toy), props and an original pixel cast; an interactive toy (BIOS POST, option-ROM checksum, clean room, HCF opcode, modem handshake with Bell 103 FSK decoded back, BBS ANSI terminal, ANSI painter with .ans export, MUD, tank and breakout minigames, Erlang B modem pools, worm and virus spread, Black Monday maths, IPO book, HyperCard-style stack, Vickrey swap meet, Gopher RFC 1436 menus, Archie index, Mosaic-style HTML renderer, 28.8k download race, Usenet flood); real history facts tagged LIT with sources (AMBER where approximate); live computed checks; ARTIST + CRITIC (24 pages) or BUILDER + WEAVER + CRITIC (8 pages) improvement loop scored from pixels; score chart, gallery, JSON/SVG/OBJ exports; a LIT check that throws. The show, its characters (named in text only) and the pixel cast (ROXY ROM, DEX DEALER, WRENCH, MADGE MODEM, BOSS BEIGE, KID CRAWLER) are MODEL; no show art, logos, likenesses or dialogue are used. Nothing goes online (WALL).

## Twelve Laws (t271)

## Cubit neon shell
Dave: "build all pages like this", with the cubit analytical · neon page (dark stage, cyan and pink, two panels).
Every Mayhem HTML page wears that shell. Twelve Laws use the two panels: analytical holds the proof, neon holds the sculpture (`{{ act || react || change }}`). Seals were not rewritten. The sample page's cartridge was not copied onto the spheres. Gray, white and black instruments (the Cameron axes, the screening-room snippet) stay in their canvases.

## Cubit register
Dave: "yes but each page needs to be {{ geomettric, constructive , agentic , generative }} use the cubis to biuld a register".
Each page is `{{ geometric, constructive, agentic, generative }}`. The four cubits are pushed, in that order, into one register. Geometric counts canvases, svgs and the measured box. Constructive counts the nodes and buttons already built. Agentic names the roles on the page (or REGISTER) and accepts the write. Generative folds those three into one code. The register is the four texts joined. Rebuilding generative from the same three cubits must match, or the page throws. A row is kept in this browser under mayhem-cubit-register (AMBER: that count is local). Thumbnail views skip it. Seals were not rewritten.
